[[Vehjin Mines]] | henchman = y | merchant = y | storage = y | pic1 = [[Image:Jennur's Horde world map.jpg|196px]] | pic1-text = On the world map | pic2 = [[Image:Jennur's Horde inside.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = A view inside }} {{Quotation|game| A rugged mining camp used by workers in the [[Vehjin Mines]], Jennur's Horde is none the less {{sic|"nonetheless"}} a booming outpost on payday, where miners flush with their spoils go broke again just as quickly in games of chance and impromptu taverns set up in the shadows of abandoned mining equipment. }} [[Jennur's Horde (outpost)|Jennur's Horde]] is the primary semi-permanent settlement for miners working at the [[Vehjin Mines]] to the northwest. ==Getting there== The [[primary quest]] [[Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger]] will conclude in this outpost. That quest, together with [[Heart or Mind: Ronjok in Danger]], represents a branch in the Nightfall storyline. While both can be completed, completing just one will make the other one optional. ==Exits== *[[Forum Highlands]] (southeast) *[[Vehjin Mines]] (west) ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== *{{x}} 20 [[Itai]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) =====Henchmen===== :''(all level 20)'' *{{w}} [[Devona]] (Fighter) *{{r}} [[Aidan]] (Archer) *{{mo}} [[Kihm]] (Healer) *{{mo}} [[Mhenlo]] (Healer) *{{n}} [[Eve]] (Blood) *{{me}} [[Odurra]] (Illusion) *{{e}} [[Cynn]] (Fire) *{{e}} [[Herta]] (Earth) *{{p}} [[Sogolon]] (Motivation) *{{d}} [[Gehraz]] (Holy) ====Other allies==== *{{x}} 10 [[Master Gardener Kobahl]] (mission access) *{{x}} 10 [[Sholhij]] (mission briefing) *{{w}} 20 [[Vabbian Guard (warrior)|Vabbian Guard]]s *{{x}} 10 [[Vabbian Noble]]s ==Notes== *The [[world map]] actually marks this location with the icon for an outpost upon initial arrival. It changes into the icon for a mission outpost only upon completion of the quest that precedes the [[Jennur's Horde|Jennur's Horde mission]], which is [[Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger]]. ==Trivia== {{gw2w|Ruins of Jennur's Horde}} * [[Jennur Kurah Hatohn]] is an [[NPC]] in [[The Mirror of Lyss]], but there is no evidence as to whether she is the Jennur referred to in the name. {{Towns and outposts in Vabbi}}
